cards.name: Direct text model service
cards.description: A fixed text model call answers, classifies, translates or summarises.
cards.caution: An application called an assistant may still be a direct service.
cards.counterexample: An agent selects tools and uses their results to choose subsequent actions.

cards.name: Document or search assistant
cards.description: A fixed pipeline retrieves passages and supplies them to a text model. Retrieval is supporting work, not a second text-generation call.
cards.caution: Search before answer generation does not by itself establish agent behaviour.
cards.example: Search manuals then answer a maintenance question.
cards.counterexample: Dynamic tool selection and repeated reasoning belong to agent orchestration.

cards.name: Agent workflow
cards.description: The model chooses actions or tools, or iterates based on tool results. Preserve the range of model calls per business request.
cards.caution: Several fixed software steps are not sufficient evidence of agent behaviour.
cards.example: Resolve travel disruption by choosing schedule and hotel tools.
cards.counterexample: A fixed retrieve-then-answer pipeline is retrieval.

cards.name: Scheduled text processing
cards.description: Text items must complete within a stated window. Batch is a schedule, not an underlying computation type.
cards.caution: A scheduled image generation job remains generation with a batch schedule.
cards.counterexample: Twelve thousand images in four hours are not text-token work.

cards.name: Video or audio analysis
cards.description: Analyse continuous video, audio or events. Text-token equations do not describe frames or samples.
cards.caution: Capture rate and inference sampling rate can differ.
cards.example: Detect objects at five frames per second on 180 streams.
cards.counterexample: Text questions about an archive are a separate retrieval activity.

cards.name: Image, audio or video generation
cards.description: Create media using a generation model. Scheduling is recorded separately.
cards.caution: Do not estimate this from text output tokens.
cards.example: Generate catalogue images within a four-hour window.
cards.counterexample: Text summaries use a text service.

cards.name: Model adaptation
cards.description: Adapt an existing model using fine-tuning. The method determines resource demand and must be confirmed.
cards.caution: Do not silently substitute full pretraining for fine-tuning.
cards.counterexample: Continued pretraining on a large token corpus uses training.

cards.name: Pretraining or continued pretraining
cards.description: Train or continue pretraining a model using a token corpus and deadline. Include ingestion and checkpoint requirements.
cards.caution: Model size and token count are distinct measurements.
cards.example: Continue pretraining on 90 billion tokens over 30 days.

cards.name: Specialist GPU workload
cards.description: Simulation, indexing-only and other unsupported computations require workload-specific measurements.
cards.caution: No text-token sizing or unsupported GPU-count claim.
cards.example: Fluid simulation with mesh size and solver iterations.
cards.counterexample: Using GPUs does not establish language-model computation.

policy.placement: scope relative to this AI Factory
policy.unsupported: requirements brief unless an applicable measurement-based method is available
